output.answer_markdown: The passages do not give the restructuring liability as of the close of Q2 FY2023. They are from the fiscal year-end (June 30, 2023) 10-K, and the liability roll-forward table is not included. What they do show is the nature and purpose of the restructuring activity under Amcor's Other Restructuring Plans. In fiscal 2023 the charges were employee-related, fixed asset-related, other restructuring and restructuring-related expenses [1]. In fiscal 2022 the charges were triggered by the Russia-Ukraine conflict, to help mitigate the impact of earnings disposed of in the Russian sale [2]. The filing also refers to an analysis of the restructuring plan liability, but the table itself is not in the material [3].
